description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: NHERI Centrifuges - A Hypergravity Laboratory Platform to Push the Frontiers of Engineering and Science is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jason DeJong, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). The Center for Geotechnical Modeling (CGM) at UC Davis provides users access to world-class geotechnical modeling facilities, including 9-m and 1-m radius centrifuges with shaking tables, to enable major advances in the ability to predict and improve the performance of soil and soil-structure systems affected by earthquake, wave, wind and storm surge loadings. Coverage: College Park, MD. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-hjsk-w310. Keywords: Hypergravity Centrifuge Davis. Published 2024-06-18. Facility named: Center for Geotechnical Modeling - University of California, Davis. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
